description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of entities (on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2^0 to 2^8) and majority voting accuracy (ranging from 0.3 to 0.6). The x-axis is labeled "Number of" and has a logarithmic scale with tick labels at each power of 2 from 2^0 to 2^8. The y-axis is labeled "Majority voting accuracy" with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 0.1 from 0.3 to 0.6. There are four lines in the plot: a dark blue line with circle markers and a solid style, a light blue line with triangle markers and a solid style, a green line with cross markers and a dashed style, and a light green line with diamond markers and a dashed style. The dark blue line starts at approximately 0.42 at 2^0 and increases to around 0.63 at 2^8. The green line closely follows the dark blue line, starting at about 0.42 at 2^0 and reaching 0.63 at 2^8. The light blue line begins at roughly 0.27 at 2^0 and rises to approximately 0.44 at 2^8. The light green line starts at around 0.27 at 2^0 and increases to about 0.44 at 2^8, mirroring the light blue line's trend. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend across the x-axis.
